narr: Runoff from heavy rain caused flooding across portions of Tripp County. Flash flooding developed; which inundated several county roads, overwhelmed culverts, and caused ponding of water in fields.
ev: Five to eight inches of rain fell within two days, with three inches of rain falling in an hour during the afternoon of June 22. Numerous roads were covered with water including 228th Street, 325th Avenue, 326th Avenue, 328th Avenue, 290th Street, 291st Street, and 327th Street. Water filled Roosevelt Lake and inundated several fields and low lying areas.
lsr: Culvert couldn't keep up, part of road (324th Ave) caved in. Two-day total, estimated 5 inches on June 21 and 3 inches in one hour on June 22.
